authority.provider: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan, CNS11643 Chinese Standard Interchange Code Full Character Database

visual_copybook.usage: independently rasterized topology comparison only; no outline, coordinate or trace enters the image-generated glyph

policy.pass_definition: Exact requested scalar and current Taiwan CNS topology/stroke structure agree; glyph is recognizable at original, native, 128, 64 and 32 px; exact 2×/4× evidence shows no thorn, debris, wrong bridge, grid contact, wrong hook or missing/extra semantic stroke.
policy.reject_definition: Any uncertainty, simplified/incompatible variant, missing/extra semantic component, topology-changing join, wrong hook, reviewed-size ambiguity, grid contact, stray ink, thorn, spur or wrong bridge is REJECT.
policy.raster_limit: A final raster establishes visible topology but cannot prove the temporal act of writing each stroke.
policy.vectorization_limit: PASS permits controlled tracing of isolated image-generated dark ink only; grid, background, antialias halo and CNS outlines are forbidden geometry.
policy.descriptor_mutation: This raster audit does not approve or modify source descriptors.

views: all 64 raw cells at exact 2× nearest-neighbour scale
all 64 raw cells at exact 4× nearest-neighbour scale
128 px, 64 px and 32 px complete isolated cells
all 64 generated cells beside independently rasterized Taiwan CNS copybook topology
method.grid_detection: Exactly five long light-grey line groups per axis detected by projection; no equal-division or guessed-grid fallback accepted. Clearance is minimum distance from L<100 ink to a cell boundary.
method.stray_component_detection: L<100 pixels in each raw cell grouped by 8-connectivity. No component below 20 px exists. The only component below 100 px is a visually located intended 糸 short point in 囉.
artifact_review: current CNS code, stroke count and stroke-sequence structure
Taiwan Traditional topology and simplified substitution
missing/extra semantic strokes and wrong turns/hooks
grid contact and stray dark components
thorn/spur, false connecting bridge and grey-grid contamination
